verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal with local commands, so a built-in Git client is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence lists local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp…), curl, scp and sftp, but never mentions git or cloning over HTTPS, SSH or the Git protocol. SSH and curl file transfer are adjacent capabilities and do not count as Git cloning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone Git repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol
